title: The Microglia–Astrocyte–Neuron Lactate Shuttle model
title_zh: 微胶质细胞–星形胶质细胞–神经元乳酸穿梭模型
abstract: In a recent study, Adler and colleagues demonstrated that microglia regulate blood glucose delivery to fuel the astrocyte-neuron lactate shuttle. As neuronal protein translation supported by this mechanism is essential for motor learning, these findings reveal how coordinated interactions among microglia, astrocytes, and neurons orchestrate neuroenergetics to support cognition.
abstract_zh: 在最近的一项研究中，Adler 等人证明微胶质细胞调节血糖输送，以为星形胶质细胞-神经元乳酸穿梭提供能量。由于该机制支持的神经元蛋白翻译对运动学习至关重要，这些发现揭示了微胶质细胞、星形胶质细胞和神经元之间的协调相互作用如何共同调控神经能量代谢，以支持认知功能。
